entrypoints.description: Next.js 16 App Router root. Only route visible to the user is / (src/app/page.tsx). Editor at /editor (src/app/editor/page.tsx).
Editor shell: viewport, panels, toolbar. React Three Fiber for 3D, shadcn/ui for chrome, Zustand for transient state.
TypeScript engine kernel + plugin SDK + architect control plane + studio + frontier + production modules.
Deterministic RNG, hashing, serialization, fixed-point, transcendentals. Proven with cross-browser hash parity.

world.reason: src/engine/world/world-fabric.ts and src/engine/frontier/world-asset-store.ts both touch world state. Canonical ownership not fully resolved. The studio/transactions.ts module provides the transaction path.

assets.reason: Multiple asset systems exist (src/engine/assets/, src/engine/studio/asset-registry.ts, src/engine/frontier/world-asset-store.ts). No single canonical owner declared.

uiTransientState.reason: Zustand store is the single source of truth for editor UI transient state (selection, transforms, panel state, logs). React state must not be authoritative for engine data.

actions.reason: Canonical UI Action Registry shared by buttons, context menus, command palette, keyboard shortcuts, and Grand Architect capability discovery.

physics.reason: Authoritative PhysicsRuntime service. Plain TypeScript class (not React). Fixed 60Hz timestep, Rapier KinematicCharacterController.

persistence.reason: Prisma + SQLite is the configured database. DATABASE_URL is in .env. Schema currently has only User and Post models (placeholder). Engine persistence is in-memory via ga:persistence plugin (src/engine/plugins/reference/ga-persistence.ts).

determinism.reason: LCG PRNG, no Math.random in simulation code, hash parity proven. Determinism hash: 7fde855dc9d17c7ba11c7d40c1dda10535a10dd269af0b37149104c256213f75
